page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-64-lssd is a member of the c4d server family, featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The instance is configured with 504.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of approximately 7.88 GB per vCPU. This high memory density positions the server within memory-intensive hardware classes. No graphics processing units are included in this configuration, and the local storage size is designated as none in the primary specifications.

Operating with dedicated CPU allocation, the instance provides predictable compute resources without the virtualization overhead or resource contention associated with shared-core models. The lack of integrated GPU hardware and local storage limits its utility for direct hardware-accelerated machine learning training or high-speed local scratch disk operations. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio offers a dense resource profile for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without paying for excess compute cores.

This server configuration is designed for memory-intensive enterprise applications. Suitable workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and data analytics pipelines that require substantial memory capacity to process large datasets efficiently.
